search_log.query: Viṣṇu Purāṇa Book 4 chapter 10 Nahuṣa Yayāti sons Sanskrit translation
search_log.outcome: Read ANU Press translation of 4.10.1–4 and 20–22; checked the Sanskrit chapter text at SanskritSahitya.org. Recorded only explicit named kinship and marriage links.

search_log.query: Viṣṇu Purāṇa Book 4 chapter 19 Puru genealogy Sanskrit translation
search_log.outcome: Read ANU Press 4.19.1–2 and cross-checked the names and parent-child sequence against the verse-numbered Sanskrit and English rendering at Eternal Raga. Kept the Puru-line Saṃyāti separate from the similarly named son of Nahuṣa.

notes: This is a source-specific downstream extension from the named Nahuṣa in Viṣṇu Purāṇa 4.10, a figure already represented in the Agastya graph through a Mahābhārata witness. It does not add a cross-witness identity edge or claim that Agastya met Yayāti’s descendants.

The passage establishes a narrative genealogy, not historical descent. Names and branch placement are preserved as this edition presents them. Repeated names are not merged across lineages or witnesses; in particular, the Puru-line Saṃyāti has a separate node from Nahuṣa’s son Saṃyāti.

The English translation and its chapter/verse numbering are McComas Taylor’s ANU Press edition. The original-language check used the linked verse-numbered Sanskrit chapter texts; no additional variant recensions were harmonized.
